decisions: No new generic validators or unrelated features before Pattern #1 and Pattern #2 are executable.
Default user-visible preset may never be knowingly rejected; constrain unsupported breadth instead of exposing broken combinations.
Pattern #2 uses single crochet joined rounds with explicit non-counting ch-1 starts because this is simpler to execute unambiguously than the prior dc version with an unmodeled starting chain.
Round 8 of Pattern #1 must be a continuous edge round and close into its first R8 stitch, not use local slip joins between petals.
Do not claim 100% execution without production plus physical/user execution evidence.
